batch_checks: Resident/stored fractional geometry, explicit air, multi-chunk replay order/revisions and unload/reload match individual installs.
Nine same-chunk cell writes notify one loaded neighbor once instead of nine times.
Nested batches preserve virtual dispatch and flush at the outer boundary.
Post-install failure flushes notifications and restores normal subsequent edits.
Null input rejects before mutation; empty batch has no notification.
Existing production rollback/retry, save failures, worker undo/cancellation, TLS multiplayer, sky and streaming checks pass.

playtest.playtest: Playtest: production Main, real GLFW/X11 input, isolated synthetic offline profile; F12 marks/anchor/named capture, saved browsing, export/import, footprint and blocking preview, four rotations, empty-space preservation, overlap rejection, live-player collision rejection without mutation, one-operation undo, placement, undo, export and import cancellation, malformed import atomicity, repeated placement, 32-resolution dependency and restart recovery; inventory and model editor regressions.
